title: Exclusions Schedule, Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** excludes the same kinds of loss at every level. This schedule records each exclusion term, the treatment of service animals and where bodily injury and third-party liability claims are handled.

| Term | Essential | Standard | Plus | Premier | Elite | Estate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ordinary wear and tear excluded | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Cash and securities excluded | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Vehicles and watercraft excluded | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Damage existing before the stay excluded | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Damage caused by the host or the host's staff excluded | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Damage by a guest's service animal covered as pet damage | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bodily injury or third-party liability claims handled by support | No | No | No | No | No | No |

The column headings are the HostCover levels HostCover Essential through HostCover Estate.

Notes to the schedule

1. "Handled by support: No" means bodily injury and third-party liability claims go to the insurer's adjusters rather than being handled by support, on every level.
2. A "Yes" in an exclusion row means that kind of loss is excluded on that level; every exclusion row reads "Yes" on all six levels.
3. Service-animal damage is covered under the pet-damage category on all six levels.
